title: Store health
hired_for: To keep the store open, the checkout working and every order paid and delivered, so no sale is lost to something broken that nobody noticed.

jobs.job: Tell me within minutes when the store or checkout stops taking orders
jobs.why: An outage on a busy evening can cost a full day of sales before anyone notices. Every minute the checkout is down, paid ads keep sending shoppers who cannot buy.

watch.metric: hours with zero orders during normal trading hours, 30 days (proxy for downtime; a direct uptime check needs a monitor the store adds)

drives.metric: revenue lost to downtime (proxy: expected orders minus actual orders in the gap, times average order value)

jobs.now_after: Example: Now a checkout fault ran 3 hours on a Saturday before a customer emailed. After: an alert within 5 minutes and a fix in under 1 hour.
jobs.who_today: nobody; found when a customer complains

jobs.job: Make sure every payment method actually completes an order
jobs.why: A card gateway, PayPal or Shop Pay button can fail quietly after an update. Shoppers who pick that method reach the last step and cannot pay.

watch.metric: checkout completion rate by payment method, 7 days

jobs.now_after: Example: Now Apple Pay completes 41% of attempts against 78% for cards. After: all methods within 5 points of each other, tested each week with a real order.
jobs.who_today: developer or founder, only at launch

jobs.job: Catch what broke after a theme, app or platform change before shoppers do
jobs.why: A new app or theme edit can break add to cart, the cart drawer or a discount code. Sales drop for days while everyone blames the ads.

watch.metric: add to cart rate and checkout start rate, day after each change against the 14 day average

jobs.now_after: Example: Now a discount code broke for 4 days after an app update. After: the drop is flagged the next morning and the change rolled back the same day.
jobs.who_today: developer, when told something is wrong

jobs.job: Keep checkout free of settings that cost sales
jobs.why: Forced account creation, extra form fields and missing express wallets make shoppers quit at the last step. These are settings, not redesigns, so the fix is fast.

watch.metric: checkout to order rate, 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example: Now checkout asks for 11 fields and forces an account. After: guest checkout on, 7 fields, express wallets first; completion up from 52% to 58%.
jobs.who_today: developer or agency at setup, then nobody

jobs.job: Keep stock counts true so we never sell what we do not have
jobs.why: When the store shows stock the warehouse does not have, orders get cancelled and refunded. The customer is let down and often leaves a bad review.

watch.metric: orders cancelled for no stock, share of orders, 30 days

drives.metric: refunds and 1 star reviews that mention stock

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 2.4% of orders are cancelled for no stock. After: under 0.5%, with a weekly count check against the warehouse.

jobs.job: Find broken links and dead pages before shoppers land on them
jobs.why: A broken link in the menu or an ad sending traffic to a deleted product wastes the visit. The shopper bounces and the ad money is gone.

watch.metric: sessions that land on a page not found, share of sessions, 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 1.8% of sessions hit a dead page, 3 links from the main menu. After: under 0.2%, with a weekly link sweep.

jobs.job: Cut cash on delivery orders that come back unpaid (market option, reads unavailable for US stores)
jobs.why: In markets like India, many cash on delivery orders are refused at the door. The brand pays shipping both ways and earns nothing.

watch.metric: return to origin rate on cash on delivery orders, 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 24% of COD orders come back. After: 15% within 60 days, with order confirmation and pincode rules.
jobs.who_today: operations lead or a COD tool

jobs.job: Prove every launch step with a real test, not a ticked box
jobs.why: A checklist that says 'payments done' means nothing until a real order goes through and a real email arrives. Launch mistakes cost the first weeks of paid traffic.

watch.metric: launch steps verified by a real customer action, share of all steps
watch.source: Shopify test orders and the launch checklist

drives.metric: checkout completion rate in the first 14 days

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 30 of 42 steps are ticked, 12 of them proven. After: 42 of 42 proven with a real order, refund and email before the password comes off.

jobs.job: Stop orders shipping to addresses that will not deliver
jobs.why: A typo in the address means a lost parcel, a reship and an angry customer. Checking the address at checkout is cheaper than paying twice.

watch.metric: orders returned to sender by the carrier, share of orders, 30 days

drives.metric: reship and lost order cost per month

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 1.6% of parcels come back to sender. After: 0.6% with address checks at checkout.

jobs.job: Keep shipping and tax rates right in every region we sell to
jobs.why: A shipping rate set too low loses money on every order. A tax set wrong becomes a bill later.

watch.metric: orders where shipping charged is below the label cost, share, 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 19% of orders charge less for shipping than the label costs. After: under 5% after rates are reset by zone and weight.
jobs.who_today: founder or bookkeeper, once at setup

jobs.job: Keep payouts landing in the right account on time
jobs.why: A payout held for a verification problem or a wrong bank detail can freeze cash for weeks. Stock and ads still need paying.

watch.metric: payouts held or failed, count, 30 days

drives.metric: days of cash in the bank

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 1 payout of $18,000 was held for 9 days over a missing document. After: 0 holds; documents checked each quarter.

jobs.job: Keep staff and agency access safe
jobs.why: Old staff accounts, shared logins and no 2 step login are how stores get taken over. One stolen login can change payouts or prices.

watch.metric: staff and collaborator accounts without 2 step login or unused for 90 days, count

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 6 accounts lack 2 step login and 3 past freelancers still have access. After: 0 and 0, checked each month.

jobs.job: Get the store ready so it holds up on the biggest sale days
jobs.why: Black Friday can bring 5 to 10 times normal traffic. A slow or failing checkout on that day loses the best sales of the year.

watch.metric: checkout completion rate during peak hours against a normal day

jobs.now_after: Example: Now last year's peak day checkout completion fell from 55% to 38% for 2 hours. After: under 5 points of drop, with a change freeze and a tested fallback.

jobs.job: Show me all reversed orders in one place: returns, chargebacks and parcels sent back
jobs.why: Money leaks out through three doors after the sale. Seeing them together shows which door is costing most this month.

watch.metric: reversed orders (returns, return to sender, chargebacks), share of orders, 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 9.1% of orders reverse and no one sees the total. After: the total tracked weekly; the biggest leg named and cut to 7% in 90 days.

jobs.job: Make order and shipping emails arrive every time
jobs.why: When the confirmation or tracking email does not arrive, the customer writes in. Each 'where is my order' ticket costs time and some turn into refunds.

watch.metric: 'where is my order' tickets per 100 orders, 30 days

drives.metric: first reply time and customer rating

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 6 of every 100 orders create a 'where is my order' ticket. After: 3, once every notification is tested after each change.

jobs.job: Keep policies real, current and linked at checkout
jobs.why: Placeholder or copied policies confuse shoppers and weaken the brand in a dispute. The checkout terms box must point to the real terms.

watch.metric: policy pages missing, unedited or not linked at checkout, count

drives.metric: tickets asking about returns or shipping terms per 100 orders

jobs.now_after: Example: Now the returns page still has template text and checkout links to an old terms page. After: all 4 policies current and linked.

jobs.job: Keep chargebacks low and fight the ones we can win
jobs.why: Each chargeback costs the order, a fee and a mark against the account. Too many and the payment provider can hold payouts.

watch.metric: chargeback rate, share of paid orders, 30 and 90 days

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 0.7% of orders end in a chargeback and none are answered. After: under 0.4%, with every dispute answered with proof of delivery.

jobs.job: Stop fake orders, bots and card testing
jobs.why: Card testers and fraud orders bring chargebacks, fees and wasted stock. Some bots also fill carts and skew the numbers.

watch.metric: orders flagged high fraud risk, share of orders, 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 1.1% of orders are high risk and all ship. After: high risk orders held for review; fraud losses down by half in 60 days.

jobs.job: Cut apps and scripts we pay for that earn nothing back
jobs.why: Many stores run 20 or more apps, some unused for months. Each one costs a monthly fee and slows the page.

watch.metric: monthly app fees with no link to sales, 90 days

jobs.now_after: Example: Now $640 a month goes to 7 apps with no sales tied to them. After: 5 removed, $470 a month saved.

jobs.job: Keep every product complete: price, weight, cost, SKU and images
jobs.why: A product with no cost breaks the margin report. A product with no weight breaks shipping rates. Gaps pile up as the catalog grows.

watch.metric: active products missing cost, weight, SKU or image, count

drives.metric: orders where margin or shipping cost cannot be computed

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 38 of 120 products have no cost and 12 no weight. After: 0 missing, checked each week.

jobs.job: Only test changes on a copy of the theme, never on the live store
jobs.why: Editing the live theme means shoppers see every mistake as it happens. A copy and a backup make every change safe to undo.

watch.metric: live theme edits made without a copy or backup, count, 30 days (proxy: theme change history)

drives.metric: hours of broken storefront after a change

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 5 live edits last month, 1 broke the header on phones for a day. After: 0 live edits; every change made on a copy first.
jobs.who_today: developer, if they follow the habit

jobs.job: Make tracking scripts wait for consent where the law says so
jobs.why: In states like California, tags that fire before consent can bring fines and lawsuits. A banner alone is not enough if scripts load first.

watch.metric: tags firing before consent on test page loads, share, per region (proxy: GA4 consent mode status)
watch.source: GA4 consent mode and a site check

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 4 of 12 tags fire before consent. After: 0 of 12 on every test load.

jobs.job: Make sure a shopper who uses a keyboard or screen reader can buy
jobs.why: Stores that block disabled shoppers lose those sales and face demand letters in the US. Most blocks are small fixes on a few templates.

watch.metric: critical accessibility errors on the 5 key templates, count

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 17 critical errors, most on the variant picker and cart drawer. After: 0 on the 5 key templates.
jobs.who_today: nobody, or a developer after a letter

jobs.job: Make product pages readable by Google and AI answers
jobs.why: Without clean product data on the page, search and AI answers cannot show price, stock and stars. The listing looks weaker than a rival's.

watch.metric: product pages with valid product markup, share of product pages

drives.metric: organic clicks to product pages, 28 days

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 55% of product pages have valid markup and 40 have errors. After: 98% valid.

jobs.job: Remove leftover code from apps we already uninstalled
jobs.why: Uninstalled apps often leave scripts behind that still load on every page. The store pays in speed for something it no longer uses.

watch.metric: scripts on key pages from apps no longer installed, count
watch.source: PageSpeed request list against the Shopify app list

jobs.now_after: Example: Now 4 old app scripts still load on every page. After: 0.
